leads.title: Diário de Justiça do Piauí - December 17, 2012 publication
leads.documents: Court of Justice of Piauí began granting same-sex couples marriage licenses through all notaries statewide from December 14, 2012 without judge's approval
leads.detail: Cited as published officially in the Diário de Justiça on December 17, 2012; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Piauí Ordinary Law No. 5,916 - Legislative Assembly of Piauí
leads.documents: Authorizes transgender and travesti individuals to use their chosen name on official documents
leads.detail: Enacted November 10, 2009 by Legislative Assembly of Piauí; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Piauí Ordinary Law No. 5,431 - Governor of Piauí
leads.documents: Bans discrimination based on sexual orientation in Piauí
leads.detail: Signed December 29, 2004 by Governor of Piauí; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Court of Justice of Piauí decision - July 20, 2021
leads.documents: First authorization in Piauí for a non-binary person to rectify documents to reflect gender identity
leads.detail: Dated July 20, 2021; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Teresina City Council bathroom bill / Mayoral law - June 17, 2026 vote and July 30 signing
leads.documents: Prohibits transgender women and travestis from using women's public restrooms in Teresina; vote 12 in favor, 5 against, 1 abstention; signed by Mayor Sílvio Mendes (UNIÃO)
leads.detail: Council approval June 17, 2026, mayoral signing July 30; LGBTQ activists claimed unconstitutional; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Brazilian Supreme Federal Court ruling - March 2018
leads.documents: Unanimously ruled transgender people may change legal gender without surgery or hormonal therapy, by application at registry without judicial document or medical report
leads.detail: Dated March 2018; nationwide application including Piauí; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Brazilian Supreme Federal Court decision - 2019
leads.documents: Prohibited discrimination based on gender identity nationwide in Brazil
leads.detail: Dated 2019; nationwide application including Piauí; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Grupo Gay da Bahia 2015 report
leads.documents: Listed Piauí as the second Brazilian state with highest risk of LGBTQ people being murdered
leads.detail: 2015 report by Grupo Gay da Bahia; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Piauí Law No. 8,808 and Law No. 8,371/2024 - Legislative Assembly / Governor
leads.documents: Declare Teresina Diversity Parade and Parnaíba Pride Parade as intangible cultural heritage, showing state institutional recognition
leads.detail: Law No. 8,808 enacted September 4, 2025; Law No. 8,371/2024 signed May 9, 2024 by Governor Rafael Fonteles; no URL visible in text

leads.title: 1st Children and Youth Court decision by Judge Maria Luiza de Moura de Melo e Freitas - 2012
leads.documents: Granted adoption rights to a lesbian couple in stable union since 2007
leads.detail: 2012 case; no URL visible in text
